limitations: This is a proposal-content and calculation review, not a production model, security, safety or user-benefit test.
No final rendered deck, architecture diagram, repository upload, rubric grade or classroom starter template was reviewed here.
The2000-token cap can return incomplete before visible output; fallback handling and workload tuning remain required.
Prompt-injection and harmful-intent controls are proposed; deterministic citation or catalogue checks do not prove semantic correctness.
The five-metric design is sufficient for a bounded pilot screen, not a population-level efficacy or industrial-safety claim.
The standalone research cost illustration uses30 assumed calendar days; the product business case uses22 assumed service days. Final token costing should use the product basis consistently.
